items.title: Permanent Supportive Housing via Adaptive Reuse
items.description: Report on expanding the permanent supportive housing pipeline through adaptive reuse of vacant commercial buildings, projecting roughly 1,200 supportive units over three years at about 40% of new-construction cost.

items.title: Tenant Anti-Harassment Ordinance — Enforcement Update
items.description: Status update on staffing and inspector capacity for enforcing the tenant anti-harassment program, including community engagement on the complaint intake process.
